name: mehfuz
description: Mehfuz Premium Dry Fruits & Commodities — storefront and admin

scripts.//: --include=dev is explicit because the build needs tsc, vite and ts-node, which hosts with NODE_ENV=production may otherwise skip.
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.//2: migrate/seed run here, not in render-build, because Render's persistent disk is only mounted on the running instance — it does not exist yet during the build step.
scripts.render-start: npm run migrate && npm run seed && npm start
